common_gain_theorem: when b=0 and e_1=e_2=0, (y_2/y_1)^2=(omega_2/omega_1)^2 exactly for every g>0
differential_transfer: when b=0, Q_hat=Q*((1+e_2)/(1+e_1))^2, which is exactly the K1044 error model
offset_boundary: a common additive b does not cancel from a two-frequency ratio and requires calibration, bounding, or an affine-invariant protocol
ownership_correction: an absolute clock scale is unnecessary for the ratio; stable mode-to-mode transfer and offset control remain required
